in_marathi.name: Avaneesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avaneesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avaneesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Avana' meaning 'sky' and 'Ish' meaning 'Lord'. This name signifies the one who rules the sky and is associated with Indra, the Hindu deity of rain and thunder.
